softwareValidation.note: Automated WebKit/iPhone evidence is not physical-device acceptance. The green checkpoint includes the refreshed offline cache, visible CURRENT APPROVAL PENDING treatment for the candidate opener, and current 2026 Missing Parties source behavior.

missingParties.definition: One or more homeowners or decision makers are not present for the appointment.
missingParties.note: Supports appointment QA and Missing Parties coaching; does not create a blanket spouse-must-be-present rule.

openingWording.candidate: I'm not here to sell you anything. I'm [Name] with Paradise Exteriors. We're doing some work here in the neighborhood. Quick question—have you ever gotten an estimate to replace your [windows / doors / roof]?
openingWording.paradisePrecedent: May 23, 2025 internal Canvass Training Manual contains the same core I'm not here to sell you anything phrase.
openingWording.fieldInstructionUntilDecision: Use only the current manager-approved canvass opening in the field.
openingWording.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_HUMAN_CURRENTNESS_DECISION.md choosing APPROVE or REVISE for the exact candidate.

curatedTargetAudit.grossoSet: 6/6 targets resolved: 3 audio/mpeg + 3 video/mp4, all nonzero
curatedTargetAudit.localProbe: 11/11 retrieved files opened successfully in ffprobe with readable duration/stream metadata
curatedTargetAudit.localDecodeIntegrity: 11/11 retrieved files completed full ffmpeg decode with -xerror and no decode errors
curatedTargetAudit.retrievedVideoCodecs: 3/3 Grosso videos = H.264 video + AAC audio
curatedTargetAudit.retrievedAudioCodecs: 8/8 retrieved audio files = MP3, 44.1 kHz stereo
curatedTargetAudit.daveScienceCanvassing: Target exists and reports 1,690,853,160 bytes; connector raw download is blocked by its 268,435,456-byte ceiling, so actual browser playback remains a physical acceptance item
curatedTargetAudit.note: This target audit establishes that the curated catalog is not pointing at missing Drive objects and that every retrievable curated file is structurally decodable. It does not substitute for real Safari/PWA playback.

internalTrainerMedia.scope: Paradise employee/internal training only; preserve REFERENCE/HISTORICAL authority labels and do not treat trainer media as current Paradise policy.
internalTrainerMedia.note: Internal-use treatment is a project operating choice, not a legal opinion. Media-rights documentation is not a Paradise University release gate under the current project scope.

physicalDeviceAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE.md record on an actual iPhone for Safari and installed Home Screen PWA, including offline behavior and actual internal audio/video playback.

humanCurriculumComplianceReview.currentnessDecision: OPEN — exact canvass opener requires named human APPROVE or REVISE decision; Missing Parties currentness is already closed from current 2026 policy.
humanCurriculumComplianceReview.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_HUMAN_CURRENTNESS_DECISION.md plus named human reviewer(s), date, exact candidate commit, and disposition in docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_HUMAN_REVIEW_SIGNOFF.md covering curriculum accuracy, Paradise policy boundaries, field-authority separation, sales procedure holds, tone, and usability.

promotionAuthorization.requiredEvidence: Explicit authorization to advance the validated branch after all other gates are PASS.

validatedBranchReadback.requiredEvidence: After authorized promotion, read back validated branch commit, dataset SHA, 78/76/2 guards, and operational URL behavior before calling the release live.

hardRule: A green software validator is necessary but not sufficient for release. Current blockers are one human opener-currentness approval within the broader human curriculum/compliance sign-off, physical-device acceptance, and explicit promotion authorization. Missing Parties currentness is source-supported and closed; internal trainer-media rights are not a release blocker under the current project scope.
